title: add RAG agent templates, tool-calling examples, and docs site quickstarts
author: Asha Patel
description: Adds a set of RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent templates, tool-calling examples, and docs-site quickstarts. Motivation: make it easier for engineers to onboard RAG + tool-calling patterns using Redwood by providing curated templates, runnable examples in redwood-examples, and step-by-step quickstarts in redwood-docs. This PR includes: 1) three RAG agent templates (faq-bot, summarizer, multi-doc-retriever) with configuration comments and recommended quantization/batching settings; 2) two tool-calling example playbooks demonstrating safe tool invocation patterns and structured JSON outputs; 3) docs site quickstarts with runnable curl/SDK snippets and a local dev preview setup; 4) small refactors to examples index and docs sidebar to surface the new content. Testing: examples include unit-level smoke tests and integration README instructions for manual validation. Docs build and preview verified locally and via CI. Checklist: - [x] Add templates and examples - [x] Update docs site navigation and quickstarts - [x] Add smoke tests and CI docs job - [x] Get engineering and DX reviews. See commits and review thread for details.
